articles.title: Pistons fans chant ‘f*** Embiid’ after technical foul on Tolu Smith
articles.summary: The Philadelphia 76ers earned their eighth win of the season at Little Caesars Arena against the Detroit Pistons. The game finished 112-106 in what was a clo...
articles.body:
The Philadelphia 76ers earned their eighth win of the season at Little Caesars Arena against the Detroit Pistons . The game finished 112-106 in what was a close affair throughout the night, as Jaylen Brown led the way for Philadelphia with 30 points, with Joel Embiid adding a double-double of 26 points and 15 rebounds.

As a matter of fact, Embiid even had a major scuffle with Detroit's Tolu Smith in the second quarter, with around 1:25 remaining on the clock. The 76ers' star initially struck Smith with an elbow to the chest, as the Pistons' star responded by swatting the ball away. The altercation eventually led to the Pistons supporters responding with chants of 'f*** Embiid,' per a post on X by ClutchPoints.

After the incident, Embiid responded by getting involved in a shoving match, which concluded with an almost full-blown scuffle. The 2023 MVP was assessed a technical foul and was seen smiling and waving to the Detroit supporters.

Needless to say, Philadelphia found enough to improve to 8-1 for the season. LeBron James also added a double-double of 13 points and 10 rebounds, and also had eight assists on the night. Brown, who was undoubtedly the star of the show, also had seven rebounds and shot 11-19 from the field.

The Pistons endured a slow start to the game and were down by 14 points at the end of the first half. Duncan Robinson was their top-scorer with 27 points, which included seven three-pointers on 11 attempts.

Cade Cunningham added 26 and also had 11 assists and seven rebounds, but it was to no avail as Philadelphia had the star power to consolidate their position at the top of the Eastern Conference. The Pistons, meanwhile, dropped to 6-2 for the season but continue as the No. 2 seed. Philadelphia will now travel to Cleveland to take on the Cleveland Cavaliers, while will look to return to winning ways when they host the Los Angeles Lakers next.

articles.title: ‘I miss him’- Nick Sirianni makes emotional Jalen Hurts admission as Eagles face Giants
articles.summary: Nick Sirianni has admitted he misses Jalen Hurts as the Philadelphia Eagles continue to deal with the quarterback’s absence following his blood clot diagnosi...
articles.body:
Nick Sirianni has admitted he misses Jalen Hurts as the Philadelphia Eagles continue to deal with the quarterback's absence following his blood clot diagnosis.

Hurts was placed on injured reserve after the Eagles' trip to London and is expected to miss the remainder of the season. The franchise quarterback has not been seen publicly since the diagnosis.

Philadelphia have turned to Tanner McKee in his absence, but former Eagles quarterback Donovan McNabb recently offered an encouraging update on Hurts' condition.

Nick Sirianni says he misses Jalen Hurts as Philadelphia Eagles await recovery

McNabb revealed that he had spoken to Hurts recently and suggested the quarterback was in a positive frame of mind.

"I had an opportunity to talk to him a little bit," McNabb said on Eagles Collective . "He's doing well. He's in good spirits."

Sirianni was subsequently asked about Hurts before the Eagles' practice session, with the head coach confirming that he remains in regular contact with his quarterback.

"Of course I've seen him, and I have no new update on anything. But of course, I've talked to him, and in constant communication with him," Sirianni told reporters.

The Eagles head coach then made an emotional admission about the impact of Hurts' absence.

"I know he's resting and recovering. I miss him like crazy, you know, and so yeah, but nothing new on that front. But yeah, I know he's resting and recovering, and you know we're all still praying for him and hoping for a speedy recovery."

There is currently no new timeline for Hurts' return, with his recovery understandably taking priority over any potential comeback.

Philadelphia's struggles have also highlighted how difficult it is to replace their franchise quarterback. The Eagles were 2-3 when Hurts went down and have since lost three more games.

They now face the New York Giants as underdogs in Week 9, with McKee continuing to lead the offence.

For Sirianni and the Eagles, the immediate focus remains on navigating the season without Hurts while hoping their quarterback makes a full recovery.

articles.title: 76ers star LeBron James identifies not-so-secret sauce behind Philly’s 8-1 start
articles.summary: LeBron James and the Philadelphia 76ers are off to a blistering start, and after avenging their only loss of the season against the Detroit Pistons, the 41-y...
articles.body:
LeBron James and the Philadelphia 76ers are off to a blistering start, and after avenging their only loss of the season against the Detroit Pistons, the 41-year-old revealed one of the biggest reasons behind it .

Philadelphia held on for a 112-106 win at Little Caesars Arena on Wednesday night to improve to 8-1, the best record in the Eastern Conference. The Sixers are also a perfect 4-0 on the road. Afterward, James pointed to the chemistry inside the locker room.

"We got a good team. Guys vibe with one another, guys like each other, guys enjoy being around each other. That has a lot to do with it too. It makes the game a lot easier when you enjoy being around people," James said, via Derek Bodner of PHLY Sports .

Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial)

James also sees some of the same traits that defined his past contenders.

"Those teams just had consistency throughout the whole year. We didn't want to take too many steps backwards," James said. "We understood what the assignment was, and we all held each other accountable. And I think early on, I kind of see that here as well, but it's a long season. And it's too early to be talking about the Finals and things of that nature. It's November 4th, I think it is."

"We got to hold each other accountable, especially on the floor, but off the floor as well," he added.

That togetherness was on display against Detroit. The Pistons rallied from a 17-point deficit late, but Jaylen Brown came up with a huge block on Cade Cunningham with 37 seconds left to help seal it. Brown finished with a season-high 30 points, while Joel Embiid added 26 points and 15 rebounds .

James did a bit of everything, posting 13 points, 10 rebounds and eight assists. He also became the first player in NBA history to make 16,000 field goals .

The early returns have been strong for James in Philadelphia . The four-time champion picked the Sixers over the Miami Heat, Golden State Warriors and Cleveland Cavaliers in free agency, signing a two-year deal with hopes of chasing another title.

So far, that bet is paying off. The Sixers will look to keep the good vibes going when they visit the Cavaliers on Friday.

articles.title: Cherries match in Prague 'pinch me moment' for fan
articles.summary: Thursday's Europa League game will see the Cherries play Sparta Prague at epet ARENA.
articles.body:
A Bournemouth fan who is in Prague with his son for the club's furthest away game yet has described it as a "pinch me moment".

Thursday's Europa League game will see the Cherries play Sparta Prague at 17:45 GMT.

Players trained on the pitch on Wednesday evening ahead of the match, where more than a 1,000 away fans will roar them on in the Czech capital.

Matt, who is in Prague with his son Felix, told the BBC: "I think it will be a tough game, we're in it away from home. I think the boys will do us proud."

He added: "Whatever happens, pinch me moment, and we're just happy to be here."

Cherries fan Laura spoke to the BBC in a packed pub filled with chanting.

"This is wild... everyone's having a great time," she said.

"Everyone's friendly, you cannot get a better team spirit than this."

She added: "[The club] has got such a wonderful community spirit and that's walking to and from the games, that's inside the pub, that's just everything - and especially when you look at it here today."

Bournemouth boss Marco Rose spoke to the media ahead of the match.

On the travelling Cherries fans, he said: "Prague is a really really nice town. My home town is two hours from here.

"It is a really beautiful town, you can see a lot of cultural things, and maybe the night life as well.

"You have good breweries and enjoy your time and be ready for the game.

Back in September, the Cherries' 2008 FA Cup nemesis Blyth Spartans' Croft Park was erased from the record books as the furthest Bournemouth had travelled for a competitive match, as they began their maiden European campaign at Real Sociedad.

On Thursday, Sociedad (512 miles or 823.9 km from Bournemouth) will be itself replaced by Sparta Prague (714 miles or 1,149 km away) as the longest away trip of all time - and one which many Cherries fans have been eagerly anticipating since the draw.

articles.title: Wembanyama pours in career-high 52 points as Spurs edge Mavericks 112-111
articles.summary: Victor Wembanyama had 24 rebounds and 52 points as the San Antonio Spurs recorded their sixth straight win in the NBA.
articles.body:
Victor Wembanyama has set a career-high ‌‌24 rebounds before sinking the winning free throw with 24.2 seconds left ⁠⁠to cap his ⁠⁠career-best 52-point performance as the host San Antonio Spurs outlasted the Dallas Mavericks 112-111 for their sixth straight victory.

The Spurs led by ⁠⁠19 points early in the third quarter on Wednesday before Dallas pulled within two with eight minutes and 17 seconds remaining and then took a 103-100 lead on PJ Washington’s three-pointer with 5:38 to play.

The ⁠⁠lead seesawed from there as Dallas’s Naji Marshall tied the score at 111 with a 3-pointer with 1:41 remaining, and Wembanyama’s deciding free throw put the Spurs back on top.

The Mavericks called a timeout to set up a final shot, but Kyrie Irving missed a contested ‌‌turnaround jumper in the lane with 2.5 seconds left, and time ran out.

Wembanyama also blocked eight shots in the win. Dylan Harper added 21 points, Stephon Castle had 17 and De’Aaron Fox scored 10 for San Antonio.

Irving led Dallas with 29 points, while Marshall had 22 off the bench. Washington finished with 21 points and 10 rebounds, and Cooper Flagg contributed 19 points and 10 boards. The Mavericks ⁠⁠have lost two straight games.

Wembanyama became the first player ‌‌in the past 30 seasons to record at least 25 points, 10 rebounds and five blocked shots in a half. He made all 15 of his free throws and ‌‌reached ‌‌those totals in just 16:37 of playing time.

Harper added 13 points for San Antonio before half-time. Irving led the Mavericks with 17 points at the break, and Washington had 13.

articles.title: Arvid Lindblad: The rookie teen sensation shaped by India who’s chasing his F1 dream
articles.summary: Arvid Lindblad smiles as he studies his racing helmet. For Formula One’s latest generational talent, this isn’t just another helmet on another race weekend: This one is personal.
articles.body: Arvid Lindblad smiles as he studies his racing helmet. For Formula One’s latest generational talent, this isn’t just another helmet on another race weekend: This one is personal. The teen Racing Bulls driver will take to the iconic Interlagos circuit in São Paulo this weekend donning a custom-designed Diwali lid to celebrate the festival of lights which this year happens to fall on race day. Born in the UK to a Swedish father and a mother of Punjabi roots, he races under a British license but carries all three flags on his helmet – the Union Jack, the Swedish flag and the Indian tricolor. “It’s an interesting mix … quite a rare one, but all three have played a big role in who I am and the way I was raised,” he tells CNN Sports at the team’s factory in Milton Keynes, England. “I’m very proud to represent India, it’s a part of who I am so to bring part of India back to F1 for me is, is very cool. “If maybe that can help inspire some young people, I think for me that would be amazing.” Connecting with his roots Lindblad’s rise up the motorsports ladder has been nothing short of rapid. After a grounding in competitive karting, one of the hottest prospects in the sport moved to single seaters in 2022 and hasn’t looked back. He progressed from Formula Three to Formula Two and then Formula One in consecutive years. As he lined up at the season opening Grand Prix in Australia earlier this year, he did so not only as the sole rookie on the grid but just the third driver of Indian origin to race in F1, following in the footsteps of Karun Chandhok and Narain Karthikeyan. The further he’s risen in the sport, the more he’s come to embrace his Indian heritage, driven by his close bond with his grandparents from his mother’s side. They moved from Delhi to the United Kingdom to start a new life following the 1947 partition. “They were very young, so they lost everything and had to work incredibly hard as doctors,” he explains. It’s that grit and determination – also instilled in him by his parents – that he credits with keeping him grounded and taking him to the very top of the sport. “I’ve been so confident from an early age to sort of chase my dreams because I’ve seen what they did, and I think for me I wasn’t afraid of saying when I was five that I wanted to be in Formula One and chasing that,” he says. “I’m very aware that I’m very fortunate to do this sport. Unfortunately, it’s not accessible to everyone. I would prefer if it was because I think then the level would be higher.” Lindblad recalls how his grandparents would attend his races as a seven-year-old go-karter in northern England, providing Indian food and support, and how during his family’s Diwali celebrations he and his nani (maternal grandmother) would make Rangolis and cook traditional dishes. “From an early age, I’ve just been exposed to the sort of Indian customs and traditions, and it just feels very much like home to me and the normal,” he says. And it’ll be a full circle moment this weekend as his grandparents will be in attendance to witness their grandson in an F1 car for the very first time. Lindblad too hopes that one day they’ll get the chance to see him compete on Indian soil. The last time an F1 race was held in the country was back in 2013. “Going back, it would be a like a second home race which obviously would be very special,” he explains. “They would never had imagined their grandson would be in Formula One but even more so be driving on at the Buddh International Circuit itself, so I think it would be very cool.” Inspired by Lewis Hamilton The 19-year-old will once again line up on a grid featuring seven-time champion Lewis Hamilton. He says that it’s partly due to his own multicultural background that he came to idolize the Brit more than any other driver as he took his first forays into the sport. “He was the only one of color, so I related to him,” he tells CNN Sports. “I thought it was cool that his rookie year (2007) was the year I was born, so he was the one who I sort of looked up to the most growing up.” While Lindblad is proud of his roots and aware of the increasing attention that comes as a burgeoning role model, his immediate focus is on racing. “I’m going be honest almost all the focus is basically on the driving,” admits the driver. “For one, I’m still very young. I haven’t really got the awareness of the world and knowledge of life to be able to try to vouch for being a role model. “I don’t think I’m at that stage yet and there’s a lot for me to learn on the driving side. “When I’m older and I understand more, I think it is important that I use that platform for the right reasons.” ‘I wanted it so badly’ With four races remaining on the 2026 calendar, Racing Bulls has yet to confirm its driver line-up for next year. Despite his relative inexperience, Lindblad has impressed in his debut season. He finished eighth in his maiden race in Australia, becoming the third-youngest points scorer in the sport’s history, referring to it as a “pinch me moment … you sometimes get a bit carried away by the weight of what’s really happening.” A sixth-place finish on the streets of Monaco is his highest to date. While there have been mistakes, he’s taken the sport in stride and says the best is yet to come. “I’ve been very well prepared through the Red Bull program. There’s obviously been a lot for me to learn,” he reflects. “I’ve been pushed very hard, I’ve come very quickly through the ranks. “I wanted it so badly that I struggled to envision a future where I wasn’t in Formula One. “It’s been a dream being in Formula One … Overall, it’s been very positive, and I can look back very happy on the first year.”

articles.title: Cristiano Ronaldo announces retirement from international football
articles.summary: The 41-year-old Portuguese legend says he will ‘hand back the number 7 shirt’ in social media post.
articles.body:
Cristiano Ronaldo has announced his intention to ⁠retire from ⁠the Portugal national team in a social media post, bringing to ⁠an end one of the most illustrious international careers in the history of football.

The 41-year-old’s announcement on Thursday that he will “hand back the number 7 shirt” marked the end of a lauded career that began more than two decades ago and finished with him walking out on the national team after falling out with coach Jorge Jesus .

“It was not an easy decision, because there are decisions that are not made only with the head. They are also made with the heart,” Ronaldo said.

“If ⁠I ever made you happy, ⁠if one of my goals ever made you hug someone, forget a worry or feel proud of our country, ⁠then it was all worth it.”

Ronaldo thanked his family, the Portuguese ⁠people, and the teammates, coaches ⁠and staff he worked with over his 23-year career with the national team.

“Portugal will always be a part of me,” ‌he captioned the announcement video.

Ronaldo has made 234 appearances for Portugal and scored 146 goals. ‌He ‌holds the all-time record for international appearances and for international goals.

Ronaldo captained the team to their first major trophy at Euro 2016 ‌and helped them win the 2019 and 2025 Nations Leagues.

While longtime peer Lionel Messi finished his career with Argentina after a much-anticipated farewell match last month, Ronaldo’s final appearance with Portugal was on September 24 in a 1-0 win over Wales in the Nations League.

Jesus kept him on the bench for the following match and said he did not plan to start him in the next one, so Ronaldo decided to leave the team’s training camp. Jesus later said Ronaldo would be welcome back and the decision to return was up to him.

The Portuguese football federation released a statement expressing “deep gratitude and immense admiration” for Ronaldo’s service to the country.

“Cristiano Ronaldo has raised Portugal’s profile and inspired generations of young people who dream of following in his footsteps; for many of us, he is the greatest player of all time!” the federation said.

It said it intends to organise a tribute to Ronaldo “in which the fans and the country can one more time applaud and celebrate a player who has given us so much”.

Like Messi, Ronaldo will keep playing at club level, and is expected to finish his club career at the end of this season with Al-Nassr in Saudi Arabia.

He is in pursuit of his 1,000th career goal and has currently scored 985.

articles.title: Tiffany Stratton, Roxanne Perez and Most Likely Heel, Face Turns at WWE Crown Jewel 2026
articles.summary: On paper, Crown Jewel does not look like a show that will seriously affect the future of WWE due to a lack of strong stakes. However, with big names like Roman Reigns, Cody Rhodes and Liv Morgan in action, there is an air of importance to this card.
articles.body:
On paper, Crown Jewel does not look like a show that will seriously affect the future of WWE due to a lack of strong stakes.

However, with big names such as Roman Reigns, Cody Rhodes and Liv Morgan in action, there is an air of importance to this card.

This is the perfect chance to deliver a surprise that could set up major stars for success into the holiday season.

Who could turn heel in dramatic fashion? Who might take the face side in the growing stable conflicts of WWE?

All signs point to Tiffany Stratton eventually turning on Chelsea Green to take the WWE Women's Championship with her Money in the Bank briefcase.

Will it happen at Crown Jewel? It would make sense.

Tiffy has repeatedly teased cashing in on Liv Morgan when the champion was vulnerable, but The Judgment Day have cost her that opportunity time and again.

While Stratton should be looking to cash in again on Liv following her Women's Crown Jewel Championship match, this situation sets up perfectly for Green to be the more vulnerable titleholder.

If Green is out on the mat while Stratton holds that briefcase, there is no way Tiffy will not call her shot and turn against her friend to be a champion again.

Roxanne Perez is still the odd woman out in The Judgment Day. While Liv Morgan and Raquel Rodriguez both hold gold, The Prodigy's role is to protect her stablemates.

At some point, Perez is going to get tired of protecting the champions and want her own shot at the gold.

If Tiffany Stratton is not going to turn on Chelsea Green, The Prodigy could choose to betray Morgan and let Tiffy take the Women's World Championship.

Even if it does not happen now, the time is rapidly approaching for The Prodigy to leave The Judgment Day and become her own star.

Johnny Gargano has had a rough 2026. From losing tag team partner Tommaso Ciampa to spending months in a catatonic state, he needed something good to happen for him.

That opportunity may have come courtesy of undisputed WWE champion Sami Zayn, who has promised Johnny Wrestling a title shot if Gargano helps him defeat Roman Reigns for the Men's Crown Jewel Championship on Saturday.

However, others keep receiving title opportunities while Gargano is left playing the minion to Zayn.

At Crown Jewel, Zayn will likely need Johnny Wrestling and Candice LeRae to save him against Reigns.

That could be the moment Gargano finally sees through Zayn and stands up for himself, setting the stage for him to earn a title opportunity on his own merits.

How Next Year's Crown Jewel Championship Matches Could Look 🌟

When Cody Rhodes and Randy Orton collided at WrestleMania 42, fans would be forgiven for assuming The American Nightmare was the heel.

He viciously attacked The Viper throughout and beat down a veteran who was not at his physical best.

However, WWE has yet to pay off the story told in that match.

That could change when Rhodes and Orton fight for what should be the last time for a while in a Last Man Standing match.

The Viper has teased that The American Nightmare will need to be his most brutal self to take him down.

If Rhodes shows that side fully against the still-popular Orton, will fans accept that The American Nightmare is still a face?

It would be a spectacular moment if Rhodes went truly dark for the first time since he returned to WWE at WrestleMania 38 and presented a new heel persona going forward.

articles.title: Unrivaled Power Rankings After Full 2027 Roster Release
articles.summary: The teams are set for Unrivaled season three. The star power is felt across all of the rosters. From history makers like Gabby Williams to rookies who set the WNBA on fire, like Olivia Miles, the new faces will be shaking up the status quo in the league.
articles.body:
The teams are set for Unrivaled season three. The star power is felt across all of the rosters. From history makers like Gabby Williams to rookies who set the WNBA on fire, like Olivia Miles, the new faces will be shaking up the status quo in the league.

Clubs were allowed to protect players based on the results of last season. While teams certainly utilized those protections, the roster differences have provided new questions to answer and created new strategies to deploy.

While we won't have any games to base it on until Unrivaled season three opens on January 8th, let's rank these rosters based on how they look on paper.

Roster: Kelsey Plum (Protected), Kayla McBride, Aaliyah Edwards, Natasha Cloud (Protected), Tiffany Hayes, Li Yueru

Kelsey Plum has been able to continuously grow her game. All aspects of that growth will be necessary for Phantom BC. The scoring has been the foundation of her greatness from the beginning. Now, her increased time as a point guard in the WNBA has helped her grow as a playmaker.

There is certainly offensive talent to pass to, too. Kayla McBride missed last Unrivaled season but was a standout in year one, being named to the All-Unrivaled First Team for the 2025 season. Aaliyah Edwards has also found Unrivaled to be a place where she is at her best as a pro. After multiple standout performances in the 1-on-1 Tournament, Edwards's next step is to help lead a team to success.

Edwards will be joined by Li Yueru as the players tasked with holding down the paint, which feels like it could be a weakness for Phantom BC over the course of the season.

Roster: Jackie Young (protected), Gabby Williams, Jess Shepard, Marine Johannes, Maddy Siegrist, Satou Sabally

Gabby Williams is coming off one of the greatest single-game WNBA Playoff performances we have seen with her Game 7 takeover. She rides that momentum straight into Unrivaled for Laces BC. Williams has the potential to be one of the best players in the league. Arguably the best defensive player in the world, she will be a nightmare to play against. Her offensive game has taken strides, making her a two-way problem.

Similarly, Jackie Young is also a certified issue for opponents on both sides of the ball. Young's playmaking leap, which began in Unrivaled and carried into the WNBA, positions her as the table-setter this team needs. Jess Shepard, Young's college teammate at Notre Dame, will also be able to help carry that playmaking responsibility.

The big key will be the defense outside of Williams and Young. The rest of this roster is incredibly offensive-focused and will have to find their defensive chemistry quickly to not be hunted by opposing offenses.

Roster: Olivia Miles, Sonia Citron (protected), Cameron Brink, Natisha Hiedeman, Rae Burrell, Naz Hillmon

The Spectacle has arrived in Unrivaled, as she will be repping Hive BC. Olivia Miles was must-see TV in her Rookie of the Year and All-WNBA First Team season. That projects to be the same in Unrivaled.

Miles' ability to force the defense to choose a coverage and then counter that choice defined an incredible season. She will have the chance to deploy this in Unrivaled. Pick-and-roll situations were a focal point for forcing those decisions, so the chemistry with Cameron Brink and Naz Hillmon will be vital to a successful offense.

Miles' Notre Dame teammate Sonia Citron struggled in her first Unrivaled season from beyond the arc, but this team will need her to find success, as will her overall scoring. Citron shot only 21.4% in Unrivaled but bounced back by shooting 34.2% for the Mystics this season. If that production follows Citron into her second Unrivaled season, the ceiling rises for Hive BC.

Roster: Paige Bueckers (protected), Kahleah Copper, Dominique Malonga (protected), Kaitlyn Chen, DiJonai Carrington, Monique Billings

There simply might not be a more automatic player in the world than Paige Bueckers right now. On all three levels, she is a threat to score as soon as the ball hits her hands. You put that in the Unrivaled setting, where 1-on-1 defense is even more accentuated. You have an incredible problem for opposing defenses.

Those 1-on-1 matchups and the capability to win them are what stand out here for Breeze BC. Kahleah Copper has made a career of using her quick twitch athleticism, wingspan, and incredible layup package to finish around defenders in remarkable ways. Kaitlyn Chen will be new to Unrivaled. This season, we saw her as one of the best finishers at the rim in the WNBA. On the defensive end, DiJonai Carrington specializes in locking opponents down.

The big question is for the bigs. What growth will Dominique Malonga show as a rim protector and defender of bigs in the paint? With her being the primary defender against the opposing team's best big, staying out of foul trouble will be a major factor in Breeze BC's success this season.

Roster: Allisha Gray, Rhyne Howard (protected), Dearica Hamby, Jordin Canada, Flau'jae Johnson, Aneesah Morrow

There is a whole lot of familiarity on this roster. Allisha Gray, Rhyne Howard and Jordin Canada just completed a run to the WNBA Finals, where the Dream came up just short against the Valkyries in Game 7. Defense was the foundation of that run. They have a coach in Teresa Weatherspoon who is going to be asking for that same dominance when they share the court in Unrivaled.

This is a super unique team, as you don't have a true center on this roster, but you have a ton of length and athleticism. Flau'jae Johnson will be making her Unrivaled debut. Having her behind Gray and Howard on the wings makes it a nonstop, disruptive defense for opponents to try to figure out.

Dearica Hamby and Aneesah Morrow will be big factors, as they will be forced to guard players who are naturally taller, but if they are able to win the boards, they are going to power this team in a lot of ways. Defense to easy offense will be the name of the game for Vinyl BC. It has the chance to power them far up the standings.

Roster: Courtney Williams, Marina Mabrey (protected), Napheesa Collier (protected), Skylar Diggins (protected), Sydney Taylor, Temi Fágbénlé

If you are looking for the team that would lead the power rankings based solely on energy levels and competitive spirit, look no further than Lunar Owls BC. If there is a loose ball, you can bet a player in a Lunar Owls jersey will be on the ground first.

Marina Mabrey was simply incredible last season for this team. Everyone remembers where they were watching the 47-point masterclass she put on in Philadelphia. The momentum she built in Unrivaled continued in the WNBA. Now, it loops back around to where she projects to be an offensive force yet again. This is a balanced roster, as you can generally place Williams and Diggins into a ball-handling, cutting role. Mabrey and Sydney Taylor as your shooters, with Napheesa Collier and Temi Fágbénlé as your forwards.

The ceiling of this team will be decided by Napheesa Collier. When healthy over the last couple of seasons she has simply been one of the best basketball players in the world. After missing last season, she will be looking to come back ready to prove the Lunar Owls BC belong back at the top of the standings. She has the right team to back her on that mission.

Roster: Chelsea Gray (protected), Brittney Sykes, Shakira Austin (protected), Aziaha James, Lexie Hull, Kayla Thornton

Rose BC simply has a lot of players that you have to respect in the Unrivaled field. Chelsea Gray was the Unrivaled MVP last season, as it wasn't much of a competition. She was second in the league with 24.2 points per game while also averaging 6.1 assists and 5.6 rebounds. Gray can decide the pulse of a game, which is a special asset to have on your team, especially in the closing seconds.

A big part of Gray's success was her pick-and-roll connection with teammate Shakira Austin, who also remains on this Rose BC roster. Austin herself is coming off an All-Defensive First Team honor in the WNBA. It was easily her most impressive offensive season, with a leap to 17 points and 9.5 rebounds per game.

Brittney Sykes is an incredible replacement for Kahleah Copper on this roster, as she will be able to fill a very similar role on the wing. The stats are eerily similar across the board between the two from last Unrivaled season. Depth will be the question mark here, but James, Hull, and Thornton will be cast in familiar supporting roles to their play in the WNBA, which should increase their comfort.

Roster: Veronica Burton (protected), Bridget Carleton, Breanna Stewart (protected), Arike Ogunbowale (protected), Kiki Rice, Izzy Harrison]

The Mist are the reigning champions of Unrivaled and will start the season at the top of the power rankings. Unrivaled is unique in the way rosters are built, so this isn't an exact copy of last year's squad. However, keeping Breanna Stewart, Veronica Burton and Arike Ogunbowale is a heck of a place to start.

Unsurprisingly, Stewart was one of the best players in the league last season, averaging a near double-double with 21.4 points and 9.1 rebounds per game. Her chemistry with Ogunbowale was constantly growing over the course of the season. Ogunbowale, in her own right, had a crescendoing two-way impact as the season went on. Finally, the momentum of Veronica Burton carrying over from an Unrivaled championship into winning a WNBA championship has her poised to take another step with her game.

Losing Allisha Gray is a major loss for Mist BC, but they are adding some incredible depth. Bridget Carleton just had a career year for the Portland Fire, with her per-game scoring reaching double figures for the first time in her WNBA career. Izzy Harrison was also able to find scoring success for Toronto. Her Tempo teammate Kiki Rice could be a breakout player in Unrivaled after an incredibly solid rookie campaign on both sides of the ball.

articles.summary: El periodista italiano asegura el club azulgrana le sigue y que varios clubes de la Premier también tienen interés en el defensa del Betis
articles.body: El Barcelona sigue atento al mercado de fichajes y uno de los futbolistas que está en su radar es Natan, defensa del Real Betis. Así lo ha desvelado Matteo Moretto en La Pizarra de Quintana, donde ha asegurado que el conjunto azulgrana está siguiendo al futbolista verdiblanco, que también despierta el interés de varios equipos de la Premier League. El brasileño, según contó el periodista, tiene contrato con el Betis hasta 2030 y está cerca de obtener el pasaporte español. Una situación que llega mientras varios clubes siguen de cerca su futuro. "Hay muchos clubes preguntando. Hay clubes de la Premier que están valorando ese posible fichaje de cara a verano", ha explicado Moretto. Se habla, precisamente, de una venta en verano y no en enero por la importancia del futbolista en el conjunto verdiblanco. "Para el Betis es demasiado importante y no debería salir en enero, por eso sería una venta para verano", ha señalado el periodista. Pero la gran novedad está en el interés del Barcelona, que también sigue de cerca la situación del central brasileño. El conjunto azulgrana se suma así a los clubes que tienen a Natan en su radar, aunque por el momento no se ha hablado de ninguna oferta ni negociación. "Me confirman que el Barcelona le está monitorizando", ha desvelado Moretto, dejando abierta la posibilidad de que el defensa del Betis sea uno de los nombres a seguir de cara al próximo mercado de verano. "Es cierto que el Barça está buscando un central de perfil zurdo, que sea rápido y pueda encajar en el estilo de juego de Flick", profundizó el periodista sobre el interés del club azulgrana. articles.title: Who Will Be in Next Year's WWE Crown Jewel Champion vs. Champion Matches?
articles.summary: WWE returns to Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, on Saturday for its annual Crown Jewel premium live event, headlined by two champion vs. champion contests featuring the company's men's and women's world champions.
articles.body:
WWE returns to Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, on Saturday for its annual Crown Jewel premium live event, headlined by two champion vs. champion contests featuring the company's men's and women's world champions.

World heavyweight champion Roman Reigns battles undisputed WWE champion Sami Zayn, while women's world champion Liv Morgan squares off with WWE women's champion Chelsea Green for the right to call themselves Crown Jewel champions.

Looking ahead, what might next year's champion vs. champion matches look like, and why might fans expect those particular Superstars to be involved?

Find out in this way-too-early preview of the 2027 event.

World Heavyweight Champion Oba Femi vs. WWE Champion Cody Rhodes

If all goes according to plan, Oba Femi should continue to steamroll the competition through the Royal Rumble, where he will win the men's match and set himself up for a World Heavyweight Championship contest against Roman Reigns.

A win at WrestleMania 43 will solidify him as WWE's new face and the beacon for the company's future. While it is possible he could lose that title in some controversial fashion by the time next November rolls around, it seems like a safe bet that The Ruler would roll into Riyadh and compete in the champion vs. champion event.

Things are less obvious on SmackDown. Any number of Superstars could be champion by next year. CM Punk, Kevin Owens, Sami Zayn, Randy Orton and a returning Drew McIntyre are all viable options.

It could even be a young star, such as Trick Williams.

Cody Rhodes makes sense, though, as he is WWE's QB1 and a natural candidate to regain the company's top prize. Beyond that, he has unfinished business with Femi dating back to December 2025 that could be revisited to build toward a rematch.

At Saturday Night's Main Event on December 13 last year, Femi represented NXT in a match against Rhodes. The up-and-coming force of nature proved himself by hanging with The American Nightmare, but McIntyre's interference handed Rhodes a disqualification victory and left their rivalry without a decisive resolution.

With Femi theoretically reigning as world heavyweight champion by next year's Crown Jewel, a story in which he seeks to beat a man he has shared the ring with but has not yet conquered essentially writes itself.

The possibility of Rhodes becoming the first two-time men's Crown Jewel champion would add further luster, depending on this year's result.

Women's World Champion Becky Lynch vs. WWE Women's Champion Tiffany Stratton

In the fall of 2023, Becky Lynch was instrumental in helping to elevate Tiffany Stratton's game and prepare her for her inevitable main-roster call-up. The result was two matches—on the Sept. 12 edition of NXT and at No Mercy—that pleasantly surprised fans with their excellence.

They have been (mostly) kept separate since, something that should change in time for next year's show.

Stratton is the reigning Ms. Money in the Bank for the second time in her career. She has yet to cash in, but all signs point to her eventually turning heel and betraying Chelsea Green when the time finally comes.

With Tiffy positioned as a top villain on the SmackDown women's roster, it would be plausible that she would be in a position to be the WWE women's champion by this time next year, even if she loses it and regains it along the way.

Lynch has not held a world title in WWE since 2024, a streak that has to end at some point. She has come close recently, challenging for the gold but falling short in matches against Liv Morgan.

A triumph sooner rather than later and a strong run with the gold through next fall would set her on a collision course with the woman she helped prepare for the main roster—and give her a chance to add "women's Crown Jewel champion" to what is already one of the most impressive resumes in women's wrestling history.

He was formally charged on 20 July but the one-month ban was adjudged to have been fully served from 22 May to 21 June.

Trout, who won his sole England cap to date against Australia last year, admitted the charge and completed an approved Substance of Abuse treatment programme.

articles.title: Victor Wembanyama may have scored the most fantasy basketball points we'll see all season Wednesday against Mavericks
articles.summary: Wemby went bonkers on Wednesday's slate, scoring 110 fantasy points in High Score and even more in points formats.
articles.body:
Sometimes you look at a Victor Wembanyama stat line and you have to do a double take. After doing just that while observing Wednesday's astonishing 52-point, 24-rebound performance in a win over the Dallas Mavericks , we had to rub our eyes and make sure it was all real.

The San Antonio Spurs' All-Star not only dropped 52 points and 24 rebounds, but also added two assists, two steals and EIGHT blocks for good measure, scoring 110 points in Yahoo High Score fantasy basketball, while putting up even more in points leagues (112.8).

The 110 points in High Score is tied for the most in the format ever, matching Bam Adebayo's 83-point game from last season against the Wizards . At the time, we thought we'd be talking about Bam's performance likely for the rest of time. Well, guess we need to add Wemby's box score from last night into that category.

And the cherry on top of the fantasy basketball sundae might be that Wembanyama iced the game with a free throw to give the Spurs a 112-111 lead, which would help them hold on for the win. The 52 points vaulted the big man's season average up to 29 points per game, which now ranks fourth in the NBA entering play Thursday.

San Antonio has now won six games in a row after dropping the first two contests of the season. Wemby will look to continue his massive fantasy week with matchups against the Kings and Trail Blazers. For High Score formats, it'll be tough (actually nearly impossible) for Wemby to top that score for managers this week, but those in points and 9-category leagues will welcome the chance at additional production.

articles.title: Jalen Hurts Gives Slumping Eagles a ‘Morale Boost’ in Visit to Team Facility After Scary Blood Clots Diagnosis
articles.summary: The star quarterback will miss the remainder of the season after doctors found multiple blood clots in his lungs
articles.body:
Hurts visited teammates for the first time since being placed on injured reserve in October

The Eagles are last in the NFC East with a 2-6 record entering Week 9

Hurts will miss the season after doctors diagnosed deep vein thrombosis and pulmonary emboli

The Philadelphia Eagles quarterback, 28, visited the team's practice facility on Wednesday, Nov. 4, with some of his teammates seeing him for the first time since he was shut down for the season after being diagnosed with blood clots , ESPN reported.

Hurts joined team meetings but did not address the club, according to the report, which described the quarterback's presence Wednesday as a "morale boost.

It's been a challenging season for Philadelphia, with the Birds entering Week 9 at 2-6.

Hurts was first diagnosed with a superficial blood clot in London last month, when he played in the team's 19-17 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars on Oct. 11. Days later, on Oct. 17, he was moved to injured reserve. The quarterback was officially shut down for the season on Oct. 19, when it was revealed that multiple blood clots had been found in his lungs.

Hurts' agent, Nicole Lynn, shared that the quarterback was diagnosed with deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and bilateral pulmonary emboli, when a blood clot travels to the lung from another part of the body, per the Cleveland Clinic .

"After further testing and monitoring, the current diagnosis is deep vein thrombosis as well as bilateral pulmonary emboli," she wrote in a statement. "He is clinically stable and has no significant functional limitations."

Lynn added that Hurts will begin taking a blood thinner and "he will not be allowed to participate in any contact activities, including football."

Eagles coach Nick Sirianni said on Wednesday that he's been in "constant communication" with Hurts.

"I've talked to him and am in constant communication with him and know he's resting and recovering," said Sirianni, who did not provide a direct answer when asked if Hurts visited the team facility. "I miss him like crazy. But nothing new on that front. I know he's resting and recovering, and we're all still praying for him and hoping for a speedy recovery."

Sirianni, 45, previously defended the team's handling of the serious health issue, including the decision to let him travel overseas.

"The health of our players is always at the forefront of our minds, and we leave that up to the medical experts, but we always, always care deeply about our players," Sirianni said. "When you are completely focused on togetherness and connection, you're always thinking about the well-being of your guys, and that's where we were in that situation."

The Eagles host the New York Giants on Sunday, Nov. 8.

articles.title: 'A void that is impossible to fill' - tributes paid at De Miguel funeral
articles.summary: Jesus de Miguel's family say "the mark he has left on so many people" is something they will always remember as the footballer's funeral takes place in Spain...
articles.body:
Jesus de Miguel's family said "the mark he has left on so many people" was something they would always remember as the footballer's funeral took place on Thursday.

The Tenerife forward, who was 30, died after suffering a serious injury during a Spanish second division match on Monday.

After colliding with FC Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono, De Miguel lay motionless on the pitch while being treated by medical staff and was taken to hospital, where he died at 07:00 GMT on Tuesday.

Owono was sent off for the challenge and the game was abandoned.

De Miguel's funeral was held in his parents' hometown of Navahermosa, Toledo, about 125km from the Spanish capital Madrid.

His Tenerife team-mates carried his casket before the service at San Miguel Arcangel.

Current Spain coach Luis de la Fuente was among the mourners, along with Real Madrid president Florentino Perez, Atletico Madrid chief executive Miguel Angel Gil Marin and former Real and Spain coach Jose Antonio Camacho.

De Miguel's agent, Manuel Hernandez, issued a statement on behalf of the family, which read: "Thank you for loving him, for remembering him and for being with us.

"We cannot find enough words to thank you for every message, every phone call and every gesture of affection we are receiving.

"Feeling such affection for Jesus and seeing the mark he has left on so many people is something we will always carry with us.

"Jesus leaves a void that is impossible to fill, but also cherished memories for all of us who were fortunate enough to share our lives with him."

Tributes have been paid to De Miguel, who joined Tenerife in the summer of 2025, with a minute's silence being held at all games in European competitions this week.

In a statement issued by his club Andorra on Wednesday, goalkeeper Owono said he was experiencing "the most difficult days of my life".

"I feel enormous pain over the loss of Jesus," he added. "I think of him, his family, and everyone who loved him."

The family also asked "with the utmost respect, that our privacy - and that of everyone who is supporting us at this time - be respected".

In the hours after the death was announced, mourners laid flowers and lit candles beneath a black and white image of De Miguel at the Estadio Heliodoro Rodriguez Lopez - the stadium on the island of Tenerife, where Monday's game took place.

"We need to grieve in the peace and quiet that this situation demands," the statement added.

"We appreciate the affection, concern and expressions of support that his loss is inspiring, and we are deeply grateful to you all."

Players want all matches postponed this weekend

The Spanish footballers' union, the AFE, made a request on Thursday for all this weekend's matches to be postponed out of respect for De Miguel.

Tenerife's match at Granada and Andorra's game against Mallorca have already been postponed, as were several midweek cup fixtures.

However, all Spanish sides in European competition have played their games this week.

The AFE said of the weekend games: "The footballers have expressed their deep sorrow for this loss and do not believe that there are the psychological and humane conditions necessary for the competition to be played in normal circumstances."

The union said its members "in every category" believed "unanimously" that the matches should not be played.

In 1996, a photographer for the Montgomery Advertiser snapped a picture that is somewhat of a legend in the world of college football. The image shows Uga V, the University of Georgia's live bulldog mascot, lunging toward an Auburn University football player during a game.

The photograph isn't just an unforgettable image ; it speaks to the depth of the rivalry between the two teams. The annual matchup is famously referred to as the "Deep South's Oldest Rivalry." The teams first went head-to-head on the football field more than 130 years ago, on February 20, 1892.

It's been 30 years since that picture was taken, and Charles Seiler, the man holding Uga's leash, told USA TODAY what led to that historic moment and what he says is the "most famous" picture of himself.

Back in 1996, football stadiums didn't have jumbotrons. So, to see the play, Seiler and Uga V had to move closer to the field to follow the action.

"It was a long play," Seiler says. "An Auburn player made a good play. Caught the ball, ran in the end zone."

The player, Robert Baker, "was going to do the Yosemite Sam thing and dance a little bit," Seiler recalls as he recreates the finger guns and does a little wiggle in his interview chair inside the suite the family and mascot have stayed in for years.

The paws, claws and tails behind college spirit

"That player came by and was fast and the dog almost lit him up," Seiler says, citing the dog's natural prey drive to grab anything that's moving fast around them. "He ran out of rope, or the dog would've really caused a problem."

The American Kennel Club (AKC) considers bulldogs very open to strangers and very playful. When it comes to how protective they are or how likely they are to react to something, they fall more in the middle of the AKC's scale.

Contrary to what some fans might think, Uga V was not trained to hate Auburn players. "He would've gone after one of our players, too."

The mascot, professionally known as Uga V but actually named UGA IV's Magillicuddy II, represented the university from 1990 to 1999. During that time, he graced the cover of Sports Illustrated, where he was named the nation's best college mascot, and appeared in the movie "Midnight in the Garden of Good and Evil." He passed away shortly after retiring and was laid to rest alongside his predecessors in a mausoleum inside Sanford Stadium.

articles.title: 3 Detroit Tigers named 2026 Silver Slugger finalists
articles.summary: Three Detroit Tigers are up for Silver Slugger awards, it was announced on Thursday, Nov. 5.
articles.body:
Three Detroit Tigers are up for Silver Slugger awards, it was announced on Thursday, Nov. 5.

Shortstop Kevin McGonigle, outfielder Riley Greene and catcher Dillon Dingler are up for the award at their respective positions.

Winners are set to be announced on Nov. 17.

McGonigle surged onto the scene as a rookie thanks in large part to his bat, as he hit .278 with 18 home runs and 72 RBIs in what could be a Rookie of the Year campaign. He is also listed under the utility player finalists for the Silver Slugger.

Greene had another All-Star season, hitting .280 with 21 home runs and 75 RBIs.

Dingler, who is also a Gold Glove winner , had a breakout year as a power hitter in Detroit, bashing 27 home runs to go with 91 RBIs and a .243 average.

articles.title: North Carolina Courage’s promising start falls short of the NWSL playoffs again
articles.summary: The North Carolina Courage entered last Sunday’s Decision Day against the Denver Summit knowing their postseason hopes were hanging by a thread. They needed...
articles.body:
The North Carolina Courage entered last Sunday's Decision Day against the Denver Summit knowing their postseason hopes were hanging by a thread. They needed a victory and for the Seattle Reign to drop points against the Orlando Pride to make it into the playoffs.

Despite a 1-0 win against the Summit, the Courage did not get the support they needed from Seattle to advance.

It was a disappointing end for a Courage team that had found its form this season, especially in the attack with 52 goals.

Forward Ashley Sanchez scored more than a third of those (20) in her renaissance year. The 27-year-old took home the regular season Golden Boot, but ended one goal shy of breaking Kansas City Current forward Temwa Chawinga's single-season record set in 2024.

Sanchez broke the American scoring record of 15 goals, shared by Alex Morgan and Crystal Dunn, and established a new Courage single-season scoring record.

North Carolina finished one place outside of the postseason with a 14-13-3 record and 45 points. For a team that once made postseason appearances a habit, missing the playoffs for a second consecutive year represents a disappointing chapter in its history.

The Courage, who won back-to-back NWSL Championships in 2018 and 2019 and consistently qualified for the playoffs after relocating to North Carolina, entered the season hoping to reestablish themselves among the league's contenders.

Instead, they struggled to find the consistency needed to compete with the NWSL's top teams, spending much of the campaign fighting to stay within reach of the eight-team playoff field.

North Carolina entered the 2026 season looking to build on the identity that has defined the club for much of its history: a possession-oriented approach built around technical midfield play, patient buildup and an emphasis on controlling matches through the ball.

The arrival of head coach Mak Lind in January marked a new chapter for the organization following the departure of Sean Nahas the previous summer. Lind arrived from Swedish club BK Häcken, where he had guided the women's team to the 2025 league title, bringing a reputation for developing players.

He introduced North Carolina to a more aggressive approach in the final third but early results were mixed. The Courage opened the season with a 2-1 victory over Racing Louisville, with Sanchez scoring both goals. A goalless draw against Gotham FC followed before North Carolina suffered a 3-1 defeat to Bay FC.

By May, the Courage had begun to show signs of progress. A 4-0 victory over Chicago Stars was followed by consecutive wins against Racing Louisville and Angel City. The team's most impressive stretch came during the summer when they won four of six matches in August, scoring at least twice in each game.

Lind was named NWSL Coach of the Month for August, while Sanchez and fellow forward Evelyn Ijeh established themselves as one of the league's most dangerous attacking partnerships. The Courage climbed as high as fifth in the standings, but perhaps the most remarkable transformation belonged to Sanchez.

Three seasons ago, Sanchez was one of the most promising young players in American women's soccer. After helping the Washington Spirit win the 2021 NWSL Championship, she became a regular presence in the U.S. women's national team and earned a place on the roster for the 2023 Women's World Cup.

Despite the momentum, she did not play a minute in the tournament and her international career stalled. Her trade to North Carolina in 2024 did not make things easier for her. She led the Courage in goals and assists during her first season, but struggled to maintain that momentum in 2025, scoring just twice in 23 appearances.

This year, Lind moved Sanchez to the left wing, giving her greater freedom. The results were immediate. By September, she was head-to-head with Chawinga with 17 goals thanks to a hat-trick performance against the Chicago Stars FC. Her performance also earned her a return to the USWNT.

In October, she scored against Spain in a 2-2 draw, her first international goal since 2022.

Ultimately, the Courage's inability to be consistent and turn performances into points cost them their playoff berth.

For much of the season, North Carolina demonstrated that it possessed a collective attacking talent to compete with the league's top teams. They scored 52 goals, but those attacking achievements were undermined by inconsistent results and defensive errors.

North Carolina conceded 42 goals across 30 matches, and its inability to protect leads proved particularly damaging. The Courage won just two of their final seven matches, leaving themselves dependent on Seattle's result heading into Decision Day.

In a league where the difference between qualifying for the playoffs and missing out can be decided by a handful of results, North Carolina found itself chasing teams that had managed to accumulate points more consistently throughout the season.

The expansion of the NWSL has also made the playoff race increasingly unforgiving. With 16 clubs competing for eight postseason positions, half the league is guaranteed to miss the playoffs, regardless of its history, investment or ambitions.

North Carolina's immediate priority should be to evaluate their roster. The main question facing the organization is whether North Carolina's approach to roster construction has kept pace with the evolution of the league.

The NWSL has experienced significant growth in investment, with expansion fees reaching $205 million for the Columbus franchise set to join in 2028. Clubs are increasingly competing not only on the field but also through their spending on players, training facilities and other resources. That changing financial landscape presents a challenge for an established club like the Courage.

In 2025, the club received a $40 million investment from Marc Lasry's Avenue Capital, but in today's NWSL ecosystem, that is a drop in the bucket. The team's lease in Cary runs through 2027, and ownership is pushing for a larger venue, targeting a minimum of 15,000 seats. They also have to evaluate whether building a proper training facility will help with their player retention issues.

Missing the playoffs does not erase the club's championship history. But in a league that continues to grow more competitive and expensive, a successful past offers only so much.

articles.title: Orioles smartly predicted to sign former Yankees, Mets All-Star starter
articles.summary: Baltimore's rotation could use some insurance.
articles.body:
The Baltimore Orioles are missing an ace.

Two seasons have passed since Corbin Burnes finished fifth in the American League Cy Young Award voting in his one season with the AL East club.

Baltimore's starting rotation could lose Trevor Rogers to free agency this offseason, and the Orioles will have to do their best to replace him if he signs elsewhere.

A former New York Yankees reliever who became a starting pitcher after joining the New York Mets could be a great option.

"Trevor Rogers has an uncertain future in Baltimore. Even if there are things to like about Shane Baz, Kyle Bradish, and Brandon Young, the O's need to make at least one external addition to their rotation this offseason. [Clay] Holmes would be a good place to start," Bleacher Report's Tim Kelly wrote.

Holmes was traded from the New York Mets to the Chicago Cubs while on the injured list with a fractured right fibula.

He posted a 4.25 ERA in nine starts in Chicago and did not appear in the Wild Card Series.

The two-time All-Star is one of the best ground-ball pitchers in the sport, inducing grounders at a 60.5% rate in 2026.

Kelly predicts Holmes will sign a two-year, $48 million contract with the Orioles that includes a $20 million club option for 2029.

"Holmes isn't quite as accomplished as Seth Lugo was when the Kansas City Royals gave him a two-year, $46 million extension with a $17 million club option for a third season. But there are definitely some similarities, as both were long-time relievers who became effective starters," Kelly added

Signing Holmes would be a great addition for the Orioles, an organization that needs at least one starter this offseason.
